item.title: Hydraulics
item.description: If it were up to me, everything on my bike would be adjustable with a 5mm allen wrench. I know that isn’t practical, but I would be willing to sacrifice a LOT of wait savings and sleekness to achieve that lofty goal. For now, I have settled on carrying a small tool kit with the essentials (4, 5, 6, 8mm wrenches, a small flathead, and a pair of quick link pliers).
